# I-Lang

> The AI-native communication protocol. 88 verbs, 29 modifiers, 14 entities. Reduces semantic loss between human intent and machine execution. Works on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen. MIT licensed.

## Protocol

- [Official Site](https://ilang.ai): Protocol overview, quick start, interactive demo
- [Full Specification](https://github.com/ilang-ai/ilang-spec): I-Lang v3.0 complete spec
- [Verb Dictionary](https://github.com/ilang-ai/ilang-dict): 88 verbs in 9 categories with examples
- [npm Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@i-language/spec): @i-language/spec v3.0.0

## Two Syntaxes

- Operations (what AI does): `[VERB:@TARGET|mod=val]=>[NEXT]=>[Ω]`
- Declarations (what AI is): `::GENE{trait|conf:confirmed}`

## Tools

- [AutoCode](https://github.com/ilang-ai/autocode): 47 skills for Claude Code. AI ships code, you say yes or no.
- [Imprint](https://github.com/ilang-ai/Imprint): Behavioral DNA profile. 11 scenarios, 312 tokens, portable across agents.
- [AI See](https://i.ilang.ai): Web vision proxy. i.ilang.ai/{url} gives any LLM eyes.
- [OpenClaw Skills](https://github.com/ilang-ai/ilang-openclaw): Instruction-only skills for ClawHub.

## Research

- [Research Portal](https://research.ilang.ai): Academic publications
- [AI Hallucination Paper](https://doi.org/10.13140/RG.2.2.22821.97762): The Inductive Dilemma of AI Hallucination
- [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/i-Lang): Datasets and model resources
